title: v2.1 release tracking
body: Umbrella ticket tracking the v2.1 release checklist and sign-offs.

title: Roll back DB migration 0042 on payments-service
body: Migration 0042 added a NOT NULL column `settled_at` without a default. Existing insert paths broke, causing payment write failures (INC-9). The v2.1 release was HELD until the migration was reverted and a backfill added.

title: QA regression backlog cleanup
body: Routine QA regression backlog worked down before v2.1. Mentioned in the release notes but NOT on the release critical path.

title: Auth token rotation dependency for v2.2
body: Checkout v2.2 depends on the new auth token-rotation endpoint. It is not yet delivered, so v2.2 is blocked until auth-service ships it.

title: Ownership transfer: notifications-service
body: Ownership of notifications-service transferred from Sam Lee to Lena Ortiz. Sam now focuses on auth-service. (The service wiki page has not been updated.)

title: INC-9 postmortem (draft)
body: Draft postmortem. Early hypothesis: INC-9 was triggered by a traffic load spike during peak hours. (NOTE: this draft was later found to be incorrect.)

title: Search relevance tuning
body: Tune search ranking weights for the autumn catalogue. Unrelated to payments.

title: Invoice rounding bug
body: Fix half-cent rounding error on invoices. Unrelated to the release or incidents.
